piece_type: Branded Microsoft Teams backgrounds (HCP/sales-force virtual meeting backgrounds)
regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)
note: Letter date per index 2025-12-15; signatures dated 12/17/2025. Text from raw PDF (Exa fetch, decoded, pdftotext).

cases.claim: “BRINGING MORE TO THE TABLE IN UPPER GI CANCERS” (Option 1, with visual of a long, curving dinner table similar to the upper digestive tract) | “APPROVED IN CERTAIN UPPER GI CANCERS” (Option 2)
cases.context: Branded backgrounds contain indication representations but no risk information.
cases.rationale: Omitting major side effects creates a misleading impression about safety.
cases.check: Rule: any branded asset (incl. virtual backgrounds, banners) that names the product with an indication/disease reference must carry risk information.

cases.cat: Broadening of indication / omission of material indication information
cases.claim: “BRINGING MORE TO THE TABLE IN UPPER GI CANCERS” | “APPROVED IN CERTAIN UPPER GI CANCERS”
cases.context: Indications are limited to specific ESCC and HER2-negative G/GEJ adenocarcinoma settings (PD-L1 ≥1, line of therapy, combination).
cases.rationale: Suggests use in 'upper GI cancers' without specifying the approved indications.
cases.check: Rule: flag umbrella disease terms (e.g., 'upper GI cancers') where the PI indication is narrower; require full indication.
